name: ModelVariant158_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant158_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (particles leave one of the slot's parts on a rising arc, fly to random targets on a sphere around the other slot and stretch upwards as they fade, then each target throws a growing, pulsing burst); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request modulo 100, seeds the targets, packs two texture images and prints the work size, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 until the particles arrive, 4 while the bursts run, then 1 once and 2; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; only the USA and Japanese discs build this header. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
